# United States Courts

> > Official resource for the federal judiciary, providing information on court operations, bankruptcy, probation and pretrial services, judicial statistics, and constitutional education.

The United States Courts website serves as the authoritative source for information about the federal court system, managed by the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. It provides resources for legal professionals, court personnel, educators, and the public on topics ranging from bankruptcy procedures to constitutional rights and judicial administration.

## Key Topics

- Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
- Bankruptcy Code and procedures
- Probation and pretrial services
- Federal court interpreters
- Criminal Justice Act
- Constitutional rights (Fourth Amendment, Sixth Amendment, First Amendment)
- Supreme Court cases and landmarks
- Judicial Business annual reports
- Federal judges and appointments
- Court Personnel System
- Evidence-based practices
- Educational resources and activities
- Jury service
- Federal Rules of Procedure

## Bankruptcy

- [Bankruptcy](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/bankruptcy): Main bankruptcy program page covering chapters and filing process
- [Process - Bankruptcy Basics](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/bankruptcy/bankruptcy-basics/process-bankruptcy-basics): Overview of federal bankruptcy process under Bankruptcy Code Title 11
- [Approved Bankruptcy Notice Providers](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/bankruptcy/bankruptcy-noticing/approved-bankruptcy-notice-providers): Directory of approved bankruptcy notice providers per Rule 2002(g)(4)

## Court Statistics and Reports

- [Judicial Business of the United States Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/data-news/reports/statistical-reports/judicial-business-united-states-courts): Annual statistical report on federal court workload and CJA representations
- [Judgeship Appointments By President](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/authorized-judgeships/judgeship-appointments-president): Historical data on judicial appointments by U.S. Presidents since 1933

## Probation and Pretrial Services

- [Officers and Officer Assistants](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/probation-and-pretrial-services/officers-and-officer-assistants): Overview of federal probation and pretrial services officers' roles
- [Overview of Probation and Supervised Release Conditions](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/probation-and-pretrial-services/post-conviction-supervision/overview-probation-and-supervised-release-conditions): Resource guide on probation and supervised release conditions
- [Post Conviction Risk Assessment](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/probation-and-pretrial-services/evidence-based-practices/post-conviction-risk-assessment): PCRA tool for evidence-based post-conviction supervision effectiveness

## Court Programs and Services

- [Federal Court Interpreters](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/federal-court-interpreters): Court interpreter certification, qualifications, and FCICE exam information
- [Juror Scams](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/jury-service/juror-scams): Public alert about jury duty fraud and impersonation scams

## Constitutional Education and Resources

- [Fourth Amendment Activities](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/educational-activities/fourth-amendment-activities): Educational activities on search and seizure using Supreme Court cases
- [Sixth Amendment Activities](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/educational-activities/sixth-amendment-activities): Educational activities on right to counsel and fair trial using cases
- [Law Day](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/annual-observances/law-day): Law Day educational resources celebrating rule of law since 1958
- [New Jersey v. T.L.O. Podcast](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/supreme-court-landmarks/new-jersey-v-tlo-podcast): Podcast on Supreme Court case about school officials' search authority
- [Hazelwood v. Kuhlmeier Podcast](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/supreme-court-landmarks/hazelwood-v-kuhlmeier-podcast): Podcast on student press rights and school censorship Supreme Court case

## Rules and Procedures

- [Special Projects of the Rules Committees](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/records-rules-committees/special-projects-rules-committees): Rules Committee projects on emergency rulemaking and privilege log practice

## Optional

- [Court Personnel System Pay Rates (law enforcement officer)](https://www.uscourts.gov/careers/compensation/court-personnel-system-pay-rates-law-enforcement-officer): CPS base and locality pay rates for law enforcement officers CL-21 to CL-32
- [Pathways to the Bench Video Series](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/types-federal-judges/pathways-bench-video-series): Video series featuring federal judges' personal career journeys
- [Transfer of Excess Judiciary Personal Property](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/business-opportunities/transfer-excess-judiciary-personal-property): Judiciary Excess Disposal System for transferring federal property
